newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products - mogas firms, others hold.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products - mogas firms, others hold.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were steady on Friday bar firmer gasoline, traders said.

Gasoline was stronger amid all the difficulties seen with three catalytic crackers getting shut-down in NWE. With tight supplies in NWE and good demand in the United States the situation for Med buyers does not look good in the short-term.
"Its hard to find material as it is, this will not help," said one.
Gas oil was quiet as buyers await easier numbers but demand for EN590 was seen in Italy and southern France.

Differentials were talked around unchanged. A European major offered a a cargo of Italian heating oil at around $3.50 above fob high quotes. This followed a trade on Thursday of an Italian at a $2.50 premium.
Outright numbers were $2.25 a tonne higher. August IPE last trade at $171.50 a tonne, boosted by a surge in the tight U.S. motor gasoline market.
Bunker fuel buyers were searching hard for good quality high sulphur fuel but only utility spec was on offer. Some traders were trying to push the latter's value lower.
Good quality material has dried up because of run cuts across the Med region, problems at crude processing unit at a Sicilian refinery and the absence of appropriate Russian barrels.
Bunker fuel would fetch close to $100 a tonne if it could be found, traders said.
One percent markets were slow, with little Italian buying seen. However Russian one percent cargoes were being worked by traders out of the Black Sea to the usual east Med outlets.
